Theorem
[Integration-by-parts formula] ↗ thm:gauss-green-theorem 1. appC:thm-2\group Gauss-Green Theorem

If $u,v\in C^1(\overline U)$, then for $i=1,\ldots ,n$, \[ (2)\qquad \int _Uu_{x_i}v\, dx =-\int _Uuv_{x_i}\, dx +\int _{\partial U}uv\nu ^i\, dS. \]
Proof

\sketch Apply subsection 1.2 to the product $uv$ and expand $(uv)_{x_i}$.

□
